# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a small boy with a dark, sullen face. He has black eyes that can express hostility, as well as sparkle with curiosity and mockery.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye exhibits an impertinent personality, often carrying himself with a swagger. He is known to whisper to classmates and cast grinning glances toward others.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## History

Anthony Pye was an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye. After initially remaining sullen toward his new teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), he played a prank on her with a mouse. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her temper and whipped him for the prank, the punishment unexpectedly earned Anthony's respect.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony is a pupil at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as his teacher. Initially sullen and resistant to her authority, he plays a prank on [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by putting a mouse in the classroom, causing her to lose her temper and whip him. To Anne's surprise, this punishment wins Anthony's respect, resolving his antagonism toward her before she eventually resigns her post to attend college.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), +13 more_
